description: This source file defines REST API endpoints for managing user files, including listing, uploading, and deleting files, using FastAPI and Supabase as backend services. It handles file validation, storage, and metadata management in a secure manner.

methods.name: Client get_supabase()
methods.description: Creates and returns a Supabase client using environment variables.

methods.name: str _ext(name: str)
methods.description: Determines the file extension from a filename.

methods.name: list_files( session_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter files by session ID"), user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Endpoint to list files associated with the current user, optionally filtered by session ID.

methods.name: upload_file( session_id: str = Form(..., description="Target session ID"), upload: UploadFile = File(..., description="File to upload (.docx, .pdf, .txt, .xlsx)"), user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Endpoint to upload a new file for a specific session, validate file type and size, store in Supabase Storage, and save metadata.

methods.name: delete_file(file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a specific file owned by the current user, removing both storage object and metadata.

methods.name: delete_session_file(session_id: str, file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a file associated with a specific session, ensuring ownership and session match.
